entries.en: Didn't Samurai play their first gig here?
entries.ro: Nu cumva Samurai și-au cântat primul gig aici?

entries.en: Wanna have a look at your menu.
Wait a sec, isn't this where Samurai played its first gig?
entries.ro: Stai puțin, nu aici au cântat Samurai primul lor gig?

entries.en: Ah, what a night. There're still legends about it. Music was so loud they had to replace all the windows... They made a new rule refusing service to nude customers.
entries.ro: Ce noapte, băi. Încă se mai spun legende despre ea. Muzica era atât de tare că au trebuit să schimbe toate geamurile... Au făcut și o regulă nouă: nu mai servim clienți goi.

entries.en: There's a special on the menu just for Samurai fans. Ribs à la Silverhand. Pricey, sure, but you won't stop licking your fingers.
entries.ro: Avem un preparat special doar pentru fanii Samurai. Coaste à la Silverhand. E scump, recunosc, dar o să-ți lingi degetele până la cot.

entries.en: [Sit at bar] Could use a drink.
entries.ro: [Stai la bar] Mi-ar prinde bine o băutură.
